name: FreeIPAPI (keyless IP geolocation)
tier_rationale: Identifiable public service with documentation and published usage terms (free for commercial and non-commercial use) and a public track record; P051 final condition 3: FreeIPAPI is community tier.

reliability.justification: Network geolocation is approximate; isProxy is a weak signal only (P051 FC3).

geo.title: FreeIPAPI keyless IP geolocation (GET https://free.freeipapi.com/api/v1/json/{ip}): country, ASN, AS organisation

terms.quote: free for commercial and non-commercial use

geo.notes: Quote: research record C0101. 60 requests/minute (rate_per_second 1.0 at 80%). The old endpoint https://freeipapi.com/api/json/{ip} answers 307 to the new host, which is called directly. Invalid and reserved inputs answer HTTP 200 with every field null (ipAddress null): ERROR 'address not accepted', never an absence. isProxy is kept only as a weak hint (P051 FC3).

notes: Owned by batch p3-G02-2 (P051 ip_geolocation). freeipapi.com (old host) is listed so that the 307 redirect of the old endpoint stays inside the provider; V3LUM calls free.freeipapi.com directly.
